units: board centimetres; pixels are raw video pixels

provenance.method: battle-finebio-stand: per static frame, the two SAM3 mask-axis endpoints of every fixed view with an axis are matched across views (projected world-up in the best-aligned view, then the pairing with the smaller two-view residual) and triangulated (undistort + DLT); length = |end A - end B|; the shared length is the median of the single-channel pipettes' median lengths and the spread their max - min; spacing is the distance between segment midlines over the stand window
notes: P20_03_01 measures 22.23 cm, within the spread of P03_03_01's 23.21 cm
provenance.claim_boundary: Segment ends are the extremes of SAM3 masks along their fitted axis, not physical tips: a mask that stops short shortens the segment and a merged mask lengthens it. The static frames are the detector's, the cameras the rig's; no number here is ground truth.

provenance.method: battle-finebio-colour sample: rows with a mask axis sampled per class and view, both axis ends read from the proxy frame (disc inset 0.5 x width, radius 0.6 x width, HSV gates); hue bins are each class's mode region of the saturated pixels at the fuller end widened by 5 degrees (`derive_hue_bins`); the visibility gate follows `ring_fraction_thresholds.rule`
provenance.ring_end_finding: the coloured ring is the plunger button at the top of the pipette, not the tip; tip indices are the other axis end
provenance.claim_boundary: Agreement is measured against the detector's class, itself an appearance vote on the same ring; a disagreement is not an error count. Hues are read from crf-18 proxies with subsampled chroma. The ring is the plunger button, not the tip: 'tip' indices are the other end of the axis under that finding.

blue_pipette.source: battle-finebio-tipseg score on trial 1: the label-free two-means split of the 3D butt-to-end length of the fused tip end over 74 triangulated frames (runs/finebio-tipseg-P03_03_01-20260929/scoreboard.json, two_state)

yellow_pipette.source: bare: tipseg on trial 1 (the yellow pipette rests bare the whole window, 265 frames); with_tip: battle-finebio-stand tips on trial 2, the median extended length over the 77 frames with a yellow_tip box attached in >= 2 views (runs/finebio-lines-P20_03_01-20260928/stand-tips/tip_lengths.json), a detector-box length and not a label-free mode

red_pipette.source: tipseg on trial 1: 346 frames, four over the prior by 2 cm (26.8 cm), not a mode; the red_tip length in tip_length_cm is assumed, so no with-tip mode

8_channel_pipette.source: tipseg on trial 1: 186 frames, two at 35.7 cm (merged masks), not a mode; the 8_channel_tip length is assumed, so no with-tip mode

length_modes_cm.method: the tracker's tip_attached (v4) reads the median visible butt-to-tip length of a track's last measured line fits against these modes: on over the midpoint by 1 cm, off under it by 1 cm; a class whose with_tip is null is never called attached. The completion prior still reads bare_length_cm and tip_length_cm.
length_modes_cm.claim_boundary: The blue pipette's modes are a two-means split of one method's triangulated ends on 74 frames of one trial, with the bare cluster inflated by hand-truncated masks and the with-tip cluster by glove merges. The yellow with-tip mode is a detector-box length from the other trial. Nothing is a physical measurement.

two_state_provenance.method: battle-finebio-stand tips per trial (the rest measurement split by whether a *_tip detector box attached to the body axis in >= 2 fixed views; the with-tip length re-triangulated from the axes extended to the tip boxes), then battle-finebio-stand tips-config

bare_basis.8_channel_pipette: the shortest bare (no tip attached) rest mode over 2 trial(s): [22.63, 30.15]
bare_basis.blue_pipette: the shortest bare (no tip attached) rest mode over 1 trial(s): [21.7]
bare_basis.red_pipette: the shortest bare (no tip attached) rest mode over 1 trial(s): [24.46]
bare_basis.yellow_pipette: the shortest bare (no tip attached) rest mode over 2 trial(s): [21.97, 22.77]

tip_basis.8_channel_tip: assumed: the median of the tip classes that were estimated (the detector never labelled this tip class on a pipette in either trial)
tip_basis.blue_tip: median of 1 estimate(s) over 12 attached frames: [5.17]
tip_basis.red_tip: assumed: the median of the tip classes that were estimated (the detector never labelled this tip class on a pipette in either trial)
tip_basis.yellow_tip: median of 1 estimate(s) over 77 attached frames: [6.13]

blue_pipette.tip_length_basis: all frames attached in >= 2 views: median of the extended minus the body segment, frame by frame; a lower bound where a view's mask already covers the tip

yellow_pipette.tip_length_basis: all frames attached in >= 2 views: the extended length's median minus the rest bare mode (the tracker measures the tip the same way; biased long by the detector box's slack beyond the tip)

two_state_provenance.claim_boundary: The tip state comes from the detector's *_tip boxes on the fixed views; a class whose tip the detector never labels is measured in one state only and its bare length may be a body-plus-tip length. Tip lengths are differences of medians of SAM3 axis extents extended to detector boxes, not physical measurements.
